片名: 人物照片＋抽象符號海報（文生圖版，基準卡）
說明: poster_photo_to_symbol.zh.txt（負責人提供的圖生圖範例）照骨架拆段、改成文生圖可以實測的版本。每一段只寫這張圖特有的內容。
版面: 上下 1:1：上半真實攝影、下半抽象符號

提示詞.畫幅: 3:4 vertical canvas split exactly in half by a straight horizontal line: the top 50% is a real photograph, the bottom 50% is a flat graphic symbol on a warm off-white paper ground.
提示詞.主體: Top half: a young woman in a rust-orange wool coat seen from the waist up, three-quarter view, looking out of frame to the left, one hand lifting her collar, standing against a pale concrete wall.
提示詞.轉化: Bottom half: her silhouette is reduced to one abstract mark built from a tilted rectangle for the coat, a single arc tracing the turn of her head and a short diagonal for the raised hand; the mark keeps the pose recognizable without drawing a person.
提示詞.風格: Top: art photography for an independent magazine, light natural grade. Bottom: deconstructed Swiss graphic design and post-digital symbol system: thin 1 px lines, geometric modules, arc trajectories, a faint grid, tiny index numbers next to the nodes.
提示詞.張力: Order against error: a precise grid with one slightly misregistered line; digital precision against hand-printed imperfection.
提示詞.構圖: The symbol is the only focal point in the bottom half, slightly left of center, about 30% of the half's width; at least 60% of the bottom half is empty paper.
提示詞.光線: Soft overcast daylight from the right, gentle shadow on the wall, no flash.
提示詞.色彩: Take the coat's rust orange as the one signal color in the symbol; one small teal mark as a function color; everything else charcoal lines on warm white #F3EFE6; the photo keeps its own muted natural colors.
提示詞.材質: Bottom half printed look: risograph grain, slight print registration offset of about 1 mm, faint scanner noise and paper fiber texture; top photo has fine natural film grain.
提示詞.文字: No headline. Only three tiny index labels in a thin monospace font next to the symbol: "01", "02", "A"; nothing else written anywhere.
提示詞.避免: infographic, many icons, clip art, neon colors, glossy gradients, 3D render, extra text, watermark, distorted hands, stretched proportions
提示詞.目標: It should read like the identity poster of an architecture studio or experimental label: restrained, systematic, and clearly derived from the photo above it.
